brandComInfo.introduce:
中国惠普有限公司成立于1985年，是中国第一家中美合资的高科技企业。在三十年的发展历程中，中国惠普始终保持业务的高速增长，是HP全球业务增长最为迅速的子公司之一。
中国惠普公司总部位于北京，在上海、广州、沈阳、南京、西安、武汉、成都、深圳等都设有分公司。中国惠普在大连设有惠普全球呼叫中心，在重庆，威海，岳阳均设有PC与打印机生产工厂，在天津设有数据中心。 [1]  
已在国内设立了九大区域总部、28个城市办事处、37个支持服务中心、超过200个金牌服务网点、两家工厂、一个全球软件开发中心、一个全球运营支持中心以及惠普商学院、惠普IT管理学院和惠普软件工程学院，现有员工3000多人。中国惠普有限公司致力于以具有竞争力的价格，为中国用户提供科技领先的产品与服务，培养一流人才、提供最佳客户体验，并最终与中国共同成长。
中国惠普业务范围涵盖IT基础设施、全球服务、商用和家用计算以及打印和成像等领域，客户遍及电信、金融、政府、交通、运输、能源、航天、电子、制造和教育等各个行业。
从创立之日起，中国惠普便将"做优秀的企业公民"作为自己立身于中国的基础。中国惠普不仅在中国推广“世界e家”计划、支持教育事业，并积极捐助医疗、环保等公益事业。中国惠普是北京外资企业十大纳税大户，并连续多年被全国外商协会评为十佳合资企业。
中国惠普有限公司总部位于北京，在上海、广州、沈阳、南京、西安、武汉、成都、深圳等都设有分公司。中国惠普在大连设有惠普全球呼叫中心，在重庆设有生产工厂，在天津设有数据中心。 [1]  
2020年7月，福布斯2020全球品牌价值100强发布，惠普排名第71位

jobInfo.postDescription:
System Testing Engineer plays a very important role on printer system testing, it serves as both quality control and quality assurance for company products. The System Testing Engineer has a breadth level of responsibility to develop, modify, and execute system test strategies, plans and suites; analyze test results to ensure existing functionality and recommends corrective action; may also develop tools and environments to automate test execution. 

Responsibilities
•	Responsible for designing and implementing coverage within his/her workflow on new features, code turmoil, and historical data within the system. Serve as the point of contact for his/her workflow test coverage. Determine where should invest testing efforts based on risks within the system. Generate test coverage justifications (TCAs).
•	Responsible for the quality of test case development, co-work with STL (Solution test lead) on execution of the coverage for his/her TCAs (Share and train the new technology/changes to execution team).
•	Analyze test results to determine improvement action plans in test approaches, execution efficiency and test effectiveness. Maintain his/her workflow content in central library to keep it relative always.
•	Work with partners to reduce escapes from system testing.
•	Conduct retrospective on workflow for future solution releases.
•	Drives innovation and integration of new technologies into projects and activities in the organization.
•	Provides guidance and mentoring to less-experienced staff members.

Education and Experience
•	Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent
•	Minimum 2-3 years’ experience

Knowledge and Skills
•	Extensive experience with multiple software quality assurance tools and processes.
•	Evaluating forms and processes for software testing and methodology, including writing and execution of test plans, debugging, and testing scripts and tools
•	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
•	Experience in overall architecture and software design for products and solutions.
•	Experience with design and integration of software running on multiple platform types
•	Good written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.
